trailhead.label: The Torre Daniele car park, Settimo Vittone, the board’s start

cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
An open, sunny vineyard slope with little shade: avoid summer afternoons and carry water for your dog.
Village lanes and a short stretch on the SP72: keep your dog on a short lead there.
A steep lane and a short mountain path (T2) on stone steps: watch your dog’s footing.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.An open, sunny vineyard slope with littl: Un versante di vigneti aperto e soleggiato, con poca ombra: evita i pomeriggi estivi e porta acqua per il cane.
